title: 🔥 DOES MAN HAVE FREE WILL? EXPOSING THE LIES OF CALVINISM! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DOES MAN HAVE FREE WILL? EXPOSING THE LIES OF CALVINISM! 🔥
📖 Deuteronomy 30:19 – "I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live."
Calvinism teaches that man has no free will, claiming that God unconditionally predestines some people for salvation and others for damnation—no choice, no chance, no responsibility.
🚨 This false teaching makes God look unjust, denies human responsibility, and contradicts the entire message of Scripture.
👉 Does the Bible really teach that people have no free will? OR is this another deception designed to destroy accountability and faith?
🚀 READ THIS BEFORE YOU FALL FOR THE LIE!

🔥 1. CALVINISM TEACHES ‘NO FREE WILL’—BUT GOD COMMANDS US TO CHOOSE!
📖 Joshua 24:15 – "Choose this day whom you will serve."
🔥 If man has no free will, why does God repeatedly command us to choose?
❌ Calvinism says: "You cannot choose God. He chooses you first, and if He doesn’t, you’re doomed."
✔️ The Bible says: God offers salvation to all, but we must respond.
📖 John 3:16 – "For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a father telling his children, "I will only love and care for some of you. The rest of you, I have already decided to reject." That is how Calvinism falsely portrays God!
👉 God desires ALL to be saved, but He gives us the free will to accept or reject Him.

🔥 2. CALVINISM DENIES HUMAN RESPONSIBILITY—BUT GOD HOLDS PEOPLE ACCOUNTABLE!
📖 Ezekiel 18:30 – "Repent and turn from all your transgressions, lest iniquity be your ruin."
🔥 If humans have no free will, why does God call them to repent?
❌ Calvinism says: "God already decided who will be saved and who won’t—your choices don’t matter."
✔️ The Bible says: God calls everyone to repentance, and we will be judged based on our response.
📖 2 Corinthians 5:10 – "For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive what is due for what he has done in the body, whether good or evil."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a judge sentences a man to prison without allowing him to make his case, is that justice?
If Calvinism is true, God is punishing people for something they never had a choice in!
👉 God is just—He gives every person a chance to respond to His call.

🔥 3. CALVINISM TWISTS ‘PREDESTINATION’—BUT THE BIBLE SAYS GOD DESIRES ALL TO BE SAVED!
📖 1 Timothy 2:3-4 – "God our Savior, who desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth."
🔥 If Calvinism is true, why would God desire all to be saved but only choose some?
❌ Calvinism says: "God’s will is to save only a select few, and the rest are created for destruction."
✔️ The Bible says: Salvation is available to all, and God wants everyone to repent.
📖 2 Peter 3:9 – "The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise... He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a doctor who has the cure for a deadly disease but refuses to give it to most of his patients.
That’s how Calvinism falsely presents God—as someone who has the cure for sin but only gives it to a few.
👉 God’s grace is available to ALL, but He allows us to choose.

🔥 4. CALVINISM TEACHES ‘IRRESISTIBLE GRACE’—BUT PEOPLE REJECT GOD ALL THE TIME!
📖 Acts 7:51 – "You stiff-necked people! You always resist the Holy Spirit!"
🔥 If grace is "irresistible," why does the Bible say people resist the Holy Spirit?
❌ Calvinism says: "If God chooses you, you cannot resist Him—you will be saved no matter what."
✔️ The Bible says: People reject God’s grace all the time!
📖 Matthew 23:37 – "Jerusalem, Jerusalem... how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!"

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man drowning in water is thrown a life preserver, but he refuses to grab it.
Did the rescuer fail? No! The man rejected his salvation.
👉 God offers salvation, but He won’t force anyone to take it.

🔥 5. CALVINISM TEACHES ‘ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED’—BUT THE BIBLE WARNS ABOUT FALLING AWAY!
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
🔥 If salvation is guaranteed, why does the Bible warn believers not to fall away?
❌ Calvinism says: "Once God saves you, you can never turn away—even if you live in sin."
✔️ The Bible says: True believers must endure to the end.
📖 Matthew 24:13 – "But the one who endures to the end will be saved."

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a man is given a free plane ticket but refuses to board the plane, is it the airline’s fault that he didn’t reach his destination?
God provides salvation, but you must continue in faith.
👉 A true believer remains faithful, not because they are forced, but because they love God.

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CALVINISM IS A DANGEROUS LIE!
📖 Galatians 1:8 – "But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under God’s curse!"

🚨 CALVINISM IS A MAN-MADE DOCTRINE THAT TWISTS SCRIPTURE!
✔️ It denies free will.
✔️ It makes God look unjust.
✔️ It removes personal responsibility.
✔️ It contradicts the gospel of Jesus Christ.

🔥 THE TRUTH:
✔️ God calls ALL to salvation.
✔️ Man has the free will to accept or reject Him.
✔️ We are responsible for our choices.
📖 Deuteronomy 30:19 – "I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now CHOOSE LIFE!"
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO FOLLOW JESUS FREELY
"Lord Jesus, I choose You! I reject every false doctrine that distorts Your Word. I surrender my life to You freely, and I ask You to guide me in truth. Fill me with Your Spirit, and help me remain faithful until the end. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
